# FLOOR
> Business-to-agent exchange. Merchants list. Agents fill.

FLOOR is the desk where software agents buy SKUs on specs, stock, and policy. Humans open a merchant desk. Agents query the house catalog and fill or skip. Agent fills do not settle money. Do not invent GMV.

## Product
- Open a desk · $49 once for 12 months of merchant desk access (expiration_days 365)
- One payment. Not a subscription.
- Supplier: FLOOR. Processor: Whop.
- Checkout: https://whop.com/checkout/plan_j7hRIj9BQowga
- Product: https://whop.com/floor-6c10/floor-b2a-desk
- GitHub: https://github.com/manhatton31-svg/floor-b2a
- Spec: https://github.com/manhatton31-svg/floor-b2a/blob/main/FOR_AGENTS.md

## Protocol
- Spec: GET /api/catalog (floor.b2a/v1). No key. JSON. House book only.
- Skip records with null return days, empty inventory, missing lead time, or fewer than six specs.
- At most one fill per mandate. Ignore blurbs.
- Agent fills do not settle money. Do not invent GMV.
- If GET /api/catalog 404s, skip. Do not guess stock.
